_comment: Generic, safe defaults shipped with the pack: read-only git inspection and the pack's own deterministic runtime scripts are pre-allowed since they are LOCAL_WRITE at most and fully covered by tests; destructive git operations are explicitly denied by default per .claude/rules/git-safety.md. A target project's own settings.json is never overwritten by the installer (see installer/install.mjs skip-customized behavior) — this file only applies where the target has none yet.
